panels.title: Before
lines: poll, poll, poll, poll, poll, poll, poll, poll, poll
Each poll blocked for up to 100 s. Agents sent three or four at once.

panels.title: After
lines: ship --status --wait: one call, up to 9 min, a progress line each minute
The result names the next call and how many calls are left.

items.name: In one 110-minute session, ship and waits took 81.5 minutes (74% of wall time).
Polls were 43% of that session's cache-read tokens (17.6M of 40.7M).
